summary: End-to-end testing of Zayado MyExtension-ai review request. All 11 backend pytest tests passed (auth login/me, vision board GET endpoints + POST /vision/analyse, finance overview/forecast/serenity/entry, wellness checkin+history, projects CRUD + timer start/stop). Frontend Playwright covered: /login -> dashboard with token persisted, /pilotage (no AuthGate when logged in, KPIs render, entry form POST works), /bien-etre (scales 1-5, notes, checkin-submit works), /espace (mission-name/rate/submit create mission, mission-timer-* button found and start clicked), /vision-board (loads without auth, displays cards, AI scores Clarte/Alignement/Ambition/Faisabilite/Equilibre + Score global 93/100, 'Analyser mon board' clickable, vb-theme-toggle switches theme).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/finance.py: import-csv-v2 references `text(...)` (SQLAlchemy text) without importing it — endpoint would 500 if called (non-blocking for this review).

routes/finance.py duplicates @finance_router.post('/finance/import-url') and '/finance/import-csv' — because router already has prefix='/finance', the effective paths become /api/finance/finance/import-url and /api/finance/finance/import-csv. Likely a bug if frontend ever calls them.
Espace mission-timer button re-renders on state change causing stale ElementHandle in tests — consider keying the button so playwright can reattach. Not a functional bug.
Backend routes/ folder contains stray JS files (AppLogsTab.js, ChatInterface.js) — should not live under backend/routes.
test_credentials: test@zayado.net / Test1234! — works against external REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL
seed_data_creation: Tests created TEST_-prefixed finance entry, wellness check-in, and one project (deleted at end of project test). Other TEST_ entries persist (negligible).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses SQLite (zayado.db) locally; user test@zayado.net already seeded. Vision Board endpoints are public (user_id=demo, MongoDB). All other modules require JWT (key 'zayado_token' in localStorage). Pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_zayado_review.py is reusable as regression suite. Note the finance.py import-url/import-csv duplicate-prefix bug for future review.
